'''4-4TM''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Musician/Legends|musician]] that served as a member of the [[Leisurenauts]], an all-droid [[Music/Legends|musical]] [[Band/Legends|band]] that performed in [[Kaas City]]'s [[Nexus Room]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>
